title: None Shall Pass
caption: None Shall Pass (V)
game_text: If opponent just deployed a character (except Leia) to a Jabba’s Palace site, use 1 Force to place that character on bottom of opponent’s Force Pile (opponent may draw two cards from Reserve Deck).
lore: Jabba’s Gamorrean guards keep a watchful eye for unwelcome guests.
